messages:
Alex Chen: FYI — Sam from sales flagged a CedarBank private deployment request. VPC + HSM + optional air-gapped on-prem packaging. Can product/infra triage dependencies + rough timeline?

Sam K. (sales): Quick context: CedarBank (mid-size retail bank) needs customer-managed keys (HSM), two DC redundancy, no public egress except customer's proxy. Target 'production' by mid-Sep; legal + SOC2 in flight. Contact: rachel@cedarbank.com :eyes:

Maria Gomez: @Alex @Vikram I grabbed their intake PDF: https://drive.redwood/.../cedarbank-intake.pdf. Key unknowns: HSM model (Thales vs AWS CloudHSM), whether they want KMS integration or HSM passthrough, and if they can expose a bastion for control plane updates.

Vikram Patel: High level feasibility: we support dedicated VPC and HSM passthrough but air-gapped on-prem will need packaging + installer. Main blockers: network egress rules, cert provisioning, ops access, and HSM driver compat. Rough estimate: 8-12 weeks once we have HSM spec and network diagram.

Jess Rivera: Rollout constraints: we need canary (single tenant) + integration tests, PS runbook, and on-call playbook. Also need SLA negotiation: can we commit to <200ms median for their 512-token baseline? Probably + dedicated nodes.

Alex Chen: Can we capture an initial dependency checklist here so we can send to customer? I'll collate answers.

Maria Gomez: ```
- Network: subnet CIDRs, NAT/proxy egress rules, allowed IPs
- HSM: vendor, model, integration (KMS vs PKCS11), certs
- Vault/KMS: do they provide KMS or want Redwood KMS?
- Access: bastion/jump host or VPN, admin accounts, SSH keys
- Compliance: SOC2 scope, audit log retention requirements
- Capacity: qps, concurrent sessions, peak tokens/day
- Backup: snapshot/export policy, DR RTO/RPO
- Timeline: desired milestones (canary, prod)
```

Sam K. (sales): :thumbsup: I'll ask Rachel for the HSM spec and network diagram. They said network team is tight on egress — likely customer proxy only.

Vikram Patel: If they insist on no outbound to our control plane we need offline installer and manual certificate exchange. That adds ~3-4 weeks extra for validation. Also need HSM driver signing for our runtime.

Maria Gomez: Question: Do we require HSM to be FIPS 140-2 L2 or higher? That affects vendor compatibility.

Jess Rivera: Bring up: monitoring — we need export of metrics to customer's Prometheus or push to our observability? If customer won't allow outbound, we need agent + pull via VPN.

intake-bot: intake-bot created ticket RF-2026-778: cedarbank-private-deploy. Assign: eng-platform for feasibility. https://tickets.redwood/RF-2026-778

Alex Chen: Next steps: Sam to collect HSM spec + net diagram by EOW. Maria to draft initial PRD + acceptance criteria. Vikram to produce feasibility note + rough task list. Meeting Friday 10am to align. :calendar:
